zh-CN.name: CAD 制图
zh-CN.description: 用户与 Agent 共同查看 2D DXF，选择实体后由 Agent 查询并提交图纸修改。
features: 工作区与 Agent 复用同一 CAD 画布
选区绑定内容版本，Agent 受控修改并保留历史
按需转换 GeoJSON、检查与导出 PNG/PDF

en-US.name: CAD Drawing
en-US.description: View 2D DXF drawings together, select entities and let the Agent commit controlled revisions.
features: Shared CAD views from workspace and Agent
Version-bound selections and revisioned Agent edits
On-demand GeoJSON conversion, validation and PNG/PDF export
